caveats: Five of the ten records came from low-quality directory scrapers (ibegin, YellowPages, Yahoo Local). For three of them (Prime Construction Svc, Sassman's Driveway, Vuk Contracting) no corroborating first-party or Google record could be found, and for Walter H Poppe the verified company is in Franklin Lakes, not North Brunswick.

Review counts on Google were often not rendered in the Maps view served to this browser (only the star average showed). Where a count is given it comes from the Birdeye mirror page, which may lag Google.

Ridge Construction's site is a Wix template; the broken contact form and placeholder testimonial were confirmed by inspecting the rendered DOM (no input fields, two empty iframes), not by submitting anything.
No forms were submitted, no accounts created, and no business was contacted. Where a form existed, only its fields and labels were inspected.
Inferences are labelled in the text; anything about inquiry volume, staffing or lost leads is reasoning from schedules and review counts, not a stated fact.
data_gaps: YellowPages and BuildZoom pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so Carls Painting, Sam's Contracting and Vuk Contracting details rely on search-result summaries of those pages rather than the pages themselves.
Instagram profiles require login for full view; the High Quality Affordable Painters account was only readable through its public header (19 followers, 0 posts).
Bing and DuckDuckGo blocked automated browsing with a bot challenge, so corroborating searches went through the search API and Google Maps instead.
Phone numbers in the batch could not be validated for Prime Construction Svc and Walter H Poppe; the numbers in the batch did not appear in any live listing found.
Google review counts for Ridge Construction, Schifano and Walter H Poppe were not visible in the limited Maps view; only star ratings could be captured.
